topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I'm holding this old teddy bear. It's the one I had as a child, the one I thought I’d lost forever. The one I cried over for weeks when it disappeared. Looking at it now, it’s been through so much—worn, a little tattered, and clearly well-loved. I remember the good times, the comfort it brought, but also the day it went missing. Part of me wants to take it back, to have that piece of my childhood again. But I know it's not mine to take. Someone else found it, gave it a new home, and I shouldn’t intrude on that. I hope whoever bought it can see the history, the tiny stories this bear carries. Maybe it can bring them some of the comfort it once gave me.
